start_collaboration.name: Start a Collaboration
start_collaboration.desc: Life is more meaningful when shared with others.

vote.name: Vote on Praxis
vote.descOpen: Rate other players' proof and send points their way.

worn_paths.name: Create more Puns
worn_paths.desc: You have a duty to your fellows. Make it so.

duels.name: Challenge players to a Duel
duels.desc: Your honor will be on the line. Wagers are encouraged.

comment.name: Communicate
comment.desc: Speak words of power and let them ripple out into the world. Or leave a comment.

retired_tasks.name: Look into the past
retired_tasks.desc: See what could have been, and also Retired Tasks. You can also talk to bugs.

weather_early.name: Spread the word
weather_early.desc: Let's face it, you like World Zero. You are now committed to the bit. Get your friends and foes involved.

propose_task.name: Propose a Task
propose_task.desc: Draft a Task of your own and submit it to the board.

pending_tasks.name: See Pending Tasks
pending_tasks.desc: Watch proposals move through review before they go live.

shortcut_sense.name: Sense a shortcut before taking it
shortcut_sense.desc: Some routes simply feel correct. You've started to notice which.

flag_praxis.name: Flag a Praxis
flag_praxis.desc: Help us maintain our community. You know what it is to play and task well. The bugs may not talk back, but they are your pals, I promise.

second_character.name: Create a second Character
second_character.desc: It's never too late to start anew.

lie_pitch.name: Make eye contact with people who make you uncomfortable
lie_pitch.desc: The best of friends can come from unexpected places.

distance_taste.name: Stand up for what's right
distance_taste.desc: You don't have excuses anymore. You know you can be brave.

see_metatasks.name: See the Metatask List
see_metatasks.desc: The Metatask Board is unlocked - read what the Factions are rallying around.

propose_metatask.name: Propose a Metatask
propose_metatask.desc: Draft a Task for your whole Faction to apply to.

albescent_glimpse.name: Now mysteries will reveal themselves to you

place_memory.name: Remember a place you've never been
place_memory.desc: Certain rooms feel already-visited. You've stopped questioning it.

apply_metatasks.name: Add Metatasks
apply_metatasks.desc: Attach a Metatask to your Praxis for its bonus — any Faction's, not just your own.

multiple_metatasks.name: Stack multiple Metatasks
multiple_metatasks.desc: Attach more than one Metatask to a single Praxis.

three_plans.name: Hold three plans at once without confusion
three_plans.desc: Your mind now files contingencies the way it once filed excuses.

join_albescent.name: [REDACTED]
join_albescent.desc: You no longer need to be told what you are able to do. You have done so much to get here.

underline_foresight.name: Maintain This Community
underline_foresight.desc: Cherish this community you have put so much time and energy into. Like SF0 before it, we never know when good things will fade. Don't let this place fade. Even if there are no more levels, even if you can't win, keep tasking.
